question: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word ‘Concur’ from the given sentence. Every time they met, he found it difficult to resist her odd magic.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. resist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Concur"** means to agree or have the same opinion. (सहमति देना)

 
 
• **Example: **All the members of the committee concurred with the proposal.
 
 
 
• **"Resist"** refers to withstanding the action or effect of something, or to refuse to accept or comply with something. (विरोध करना)
 
 
• **Example: **He tried to resist the temptation to eat the cake.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'concur' **is **'resist'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. resist.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Met** (मिला): Come into the presence or company of someone by chance or arrangement.

 
 
• **Example:** They met for the first time at a conference.
 
 
 
• **Difficult** (कठिन): Needing much effort or skill to accomplish, deal with, or understand.
 
 
• **Example: **She found the exam questions difficult to answer.
 
 
 
• **Found** (पाया): Discover or perceive by chance or unexpectedly.
 
 
• **Example:** She found a rare coin in her backyard.
